text:
```yaml
name: Mark stale issues and pull requests

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "30 1 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  stale:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          # General settings
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          
          # Timing configuration
          days-before-stale: 90
          days-before-close: 60
          
          # Labels
          stale-issue-label: "stale"
          stale-pr-label: "stale"
          exempt-issue-labels: "lifecycle/frozen,help-wanted,good-first-issue,pinned"
          exempt-pr-labels: "lifecycle/frozen,help-wanted,good-first-issue,pinned"
          
          # Exempt conditions
          exempt-all-assignees: true
          exempt-all-milestones: true
          
          # Messages
          stale-issue-message: >
            This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had
            recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs.
            Thank you for your contributions! If you'd like to keep this issue open,
            please comment with an update or simply remove the stale label.
          stale-pr-message: >
            This pull request has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had
            recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs.
            Thank you for your contributions! If you'd like to keep this PR open,
            please comment with an update or simply remove the stale label.
          close-issue-message: >
            This issue has been closed due to inactivity. If you believe this is still relevant,
            please reopen it or create a new one. Thanks for your interest in the project!
          close-pr-message: >
            This pull request has been closed due to inactivity. If you believe this is still relevant,
            please reopen it or create a new one. Thanks for your interest in the project!
          
          # Behavior
          remove-stale-when-updated: true
          ascending: true
          operations-per-run: 100
```
